title: Asbestos: Find It, Stop, Report
whatItIs: Asbestos was used in buildings until 1999. Left alone in good condition the risk is low, but disturbing it releases fibres you can't see, smell or feel.
keyFacts: Asbestos is the greatest cause of work-related deaths in Great Britain: around 5,000 people die every year.
It causes mesothelioma, lung cancer and asbestosis. Symptoms take 15 to 60 years to appear, and there's no cure.
Any building built or refurbished before 2000 could contain asbestos.

keyFacts.text: Employers MUST NOT start work that could disturb asbestos without finding out if it's there, or assuming it is.
Higher-risk work, like removing pipe lagging or sprayed coating, MUST be done by an HSE-licensed contractor.
Employers MUST give asbestos training to anyone who is, or may be, exposed to it.

visual.caption: If you find something you think is asbestos

items.title: Stop work
items.text: Straight away. Don't drill, cut or break it any further.

items.title: Keep people away
items.text: Put up a warning sign and make sure nobody enters the area.

items.title: Report it
items.text: Tell whoever is in charge. They check the asbestos register or survey.

items.title: Wait
items.text: Don't restart until it's been decided how the work can be done safely.

a.label: Licensed work
points: Higher risk: pipe lagging, sprayed coating, loose fill
Most work on asbestos insulating board
Only by a contractor licensed by HSE

b.label: Non-licensed work
points: Lower risk, e.g. drilling a hole in asbestos cement
Still needs a risk assessment, a plan and controls
Only by workers trained for it

onTheTest.question: While drilling a wall you uncover material you think may contain asbestos. What should you do first?
options: Wet it and carry on carefully
Stop work and tell your supervisor
Sweep up the dust and bag it
Put on a dust mask and finish the hole
onTheTest.why: HSE: if you come across material you think may contain asbestos, stop work and speak to your employer. Don't continue until it's been checked.

onTheTest.question: Which job must only be done by an HSE-licensed asbestos contractor?
options: Drilling a hole in asbestos cement
Cleaning debris from an asbestos cement gutter
onTheTest.why: HSE lists pre-formed insulation such as pipe lagging as licensed work. The other jobs are lower-risk tasks covered by HSE's Asbestos essentials sheets.

traps: Asbestos awareness training doesn't allow you to work on asbestos.
Never sweep asbestos dust: use a Type H vacuum cleaner or wet rags.
A survey may not find everything: asbestos can still be hidden in the building.
Smoking makes lung cancer from asbestos much more likely.
